explanation: I grepped Mathlib for `isLocal_iff_isIso_map` and for statements of the form `IsIso (G.map f)`. The only other hit is in Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Sites/Localization.lean (line 60), which states `J.W f ↔ IsIso (G.map f)`. Its proof calls the target theorem (`ObjectProperty.isLocal_iff_isIso_map adj f`), so it is circular and does not count. I found no independent declaration, in Mathlib, Batteries or Lean core, stating that a morphism is local with respect to the essential image of a fully faithful right adjoint exactly when its image under the left adjoint is an isomorphism.
